rows.grounds: fused compound yathābhīṣṭa + prada; legacy gloss as-desired+giving

items.question: What is ascertained in Uddamara concerning giving men their desired boons?
premises: The verse states desired-giving is ascertained.
items.inference: Desired boons for men are ascertained in Uddamara.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of uḍḍāmara remains uncertain.
items.plain_english: In Uddamara it is ascertained that men are given what they desire.
